title: Headings and Paragraphs
description: Headings and paragraphs are used to organize and present text content on a webpage.
Headings range from <h1> to <h6>, with <h1> being the largest and most important heading.

Paragraphs are created using the

tag and are used to display blocks of text.
Proper use of headings and paragraphs improves readability and helps users easily understand the structure and purpose of the content on a webpage.

example.code:
Main Heading

Sub Heading

This is a paragraph describing the topic.
example.output:
Main Heading
Sub Heading
This is a paragraph describing the topic.
